mechanism: Both drugs can cause renal impairment and electrolyte abnormalities; topiramate is associated with metabolic acidosis and carbonic anhydrase inhibition effects, while zoledronic acid carries risk of acute kidney injury and electrolyte disturbances.
action: Monitor renal function (creatinine, eGFR), electrolytes (calcium, phosphate, magnesium), and acid-base status regularly; ensure adequate hydration and consider dose adjustments if renal function declines.
